'''Wicke's father''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. His son [[Wicke]] was a member of the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] and his father thought he did a good job, unaware that his son was corrupt and addicted to stims.<ref>{{TORcite|type=class|Smuggler|Camp Vigil|Balmorra}}</ref>
